statements.description: Task returned with status state "TASK_STATE_COMPLETED" — the task has been fully processed and a result artifact is present.

statements.subject: task
statements.description: Scenario: Client asks a question and receives a completed task response. POST /message:send returns HTTP 200 with a task object whose status.state is TASK_STATE_COMPLETED and whose artifacts array contains the result.
actions: client sends POST /message:send with message role=ROLE_USER and parts containing user query
server returns HTTP 200 with task containing id, contextId, status.state=TASK_STATE_COMPLETED, and artifacts array
